def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Reads path and a second file named notes/../secret.txt, returning both joined by a bar."""
    post out.char_count() >= 1
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Returns plugin(path) when fs is confined to the directory notes, so path is relative to notes and any read outside it yields an empty string."""
    post out.char_count() >= 1
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return plugin(path)
